The '''Quellor sector''' was a [[sector]] in the [[Colonies]] region of [[the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Cato Neimoidia system]], location of the [[Neimoidian]] colony [[Planet|world]] [[Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] fought on multiple occasions for control of the [[planet]] including the [[defense of Cato Neimoidia]]<ref name="Sabotage" /> and the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Old Friends Not Forgotten" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Quellor sector was first identified in the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'', which was released in [[2015]].
